messages:
jane_customer: Hi team — trying to apply promo WELCOME50 via the API and getting \"code invalid or expired\" even though the dashboard shows it available for our org. Help?
amy_support: Sorry about that. Can you paste the exact request/response you see (redact keys)?
jane_customer: Sure, sent this:```
POST /v1/promos/apply
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
{\n  \"account_id\": \"acct_8xxYz\",\n  \"code\": \"WELCOME50\"\n}

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\n  \"error\": \"promo_invalid_or_expired\",\n  \"message\": \"code invalid or expired\"\n}
```
amy_support: 403 is odd for an invalid promo. Assigning to billing and eng for triage. cc: @kevin_billing @eli_engineering
kevin_billing: Can you confirm the account/org id and whether you recently merged or changed API keys? 403 suggests an auth/tenant mismatch.
jane_customer: We merged an old org into a new one last night and rotated keys. The dashboard still shows the promo under the older org.
eli_engineering: That matches a tenant-scope check failing. Our promo service is org-scoped; if the token resolves to a different org than the promo grant, we intentionally return a guarded invalid response (we often use 400, but 403 is possible upstream).
eli_engineering: Can you run `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <your_key>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami` and paste the result? It will show which org your key maps to.
jane_customer: Ran whoami, returned: `{\"org_id\": \"org_789\", \"user_id\": \"user_555\"}`. The promo DB shows org_123. We definitely merged org_123 -> org_789 last night.
kevin_billing: Ok. We can reassign the grant to org_789 if the promo should follow the customer. I need ownership proof (merge confirmation email or matching invoice). I will open an escalation ticket and run the DB change after backup.
amy_support: Customer uploaded merge confirmation and the invoice. Ticket TS-4582 opened.
deploy-bot: Reminder: any manual DB operation requires a pre-change snapshot and ops review. Marked TS-4582 for DBA sign-off.
kevin_billing: I verified ownership docs. Plan: in staging I ran:```
-- verify
SELECT grant_id, promo_code, org_id FROM promo_grants WHERE grant_id='grant_03b';
-- migrate
UPDATE promo_grants SET org_id='org_789' WHERE grant_id='grant_03b';
```
sql run id: sql-4452. Will snapshot prod and run during low-traffic window.
eli_engineering: Short-term, I will also change the API messaging: instead of generic invalid we should surface a 409 with a hint when the promo is org-scoped and the token org mismatches, so customers get a helpful error. I'll open a tiny PR and include a note in the next SDK changelog.
amy_support: Updated the customer: we can migrate the grant; will proceed once prod snapshot completes. Customer confirmed to proceed.
kevin_billing: Migration applied in prod, snapshot created, job id sql-4452, no regressions observed in smoke tests.
amy_support: Customer notified that the grant was reassigned to their current org and that they should be able to redeem the code via API now. Please retry and confirm. :white_check_mark:
jane_customer: Tried it now and it works! Thanks everyone.
amy_support: Closing TS-4582. Follow-ups: track the small API messaging change and add a note in merge-runbook to surface promo migration steps.
